sql.text: SELECT mm."modelId" as "id", m."name", m."sfwName", m."coverImageId", m."sfwCoverImageId", m."description", m."sfwDescription", m."allowNoCredit", m."allowCommercialUse", m."allowDerivatives", m."allowDifferentLicense", m."type", mm."minor", m."sfwOnly", mm."poi", m."nsfw", mm."nsfwLevel", mm."status", m."createdAt", mm."lastVersionAt", m."publishedAt", m."locked", m."meta", mm."mode", mm."availability", jsonb_build_object( 'downloadCount', mm."downloadCount", 'thumbsUpCount', mm."thumbsUpCount", 'thumbsDownCount', mm."thumbsDownCount", 'commentCount', mm."commentCount", 'collectedCount', mm."collectedCount", 'tippedAmountCount', mm."tippedAmountCount" ) as "rank", mm."userId", CONCAT(mm."thumbsUpCount", '|', mm."downloadCount", '|', mm."modelId") as "cursorId" FROM "ModelMetric" mm JOIN "Model" m ON m."id" = mm."modelId" WHERE (mm."mode" IS NULL OR mm."mode" != $1::"ModelModifier") AND ( mm."mode" IS DISTINCT FROM $2::"ModelModifier" OR ($3::boolean AND mm."userId" = $4) OR $5::boolean ) AND (mm."poi" = false OR mm."userId" = $6) AND mm."status" = $7::"ModelStatus" AND mm."availability" != 'Private'::"Availability" AND (mm."nsfwLevel" & $8) != 0 ORDER BY mm."thumbsUpCount" DESC, mm."downloadCount" DESC, mm."modelId" LIMIT $9
